verdict.rationale: v0 provides an official platform API and a public SDK (v0-sdk on GitHub) with concrete code examples (chats.create, readV0Stream, chats.init) letting developers build custom integrations and chat interfaces programmatically, backed by first-party API docs describing full platform access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the SDK in production and broader multi-language SDK coverage beyond the JS/TS examples shown.
